verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The dominated divisorial approximation is established for arbitrary semivaluations, including proper-support and infinite-value cases, and it validly yields the all-point comparison principle. The main construction then uses the MP decreasing-model definition, the finite-energy correspondence, exact DXZ order reflection, endpoint control at the trivial valuation, and the decreasing-infimum formula to construct a non-collapsing DXZ infimum whose raw transform equals the prescribed MP potential first on rational divisorial points and then everywhere by the assumed upper semicontinuity. Divisorial injectivity proves uniqueness and model-net independence, and the same order criterion proves preservation and reflection of order. The external MP, Xia, and Darvas–Xia–Zhang statements cited in these steps were checked against their primary texts and match the uses made here.
